title: [CQ-I02] JetBrains contract review
description:
Objective: Update primary client profile settings, approval invalidation, revision tokens and evidence status.

Deliverable: JetBrains contract review. This is task I02 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): I01, F05, V06.
definitionOfDone: Every approval entrypoint sends rendered revision.
Missing/stale approval cannot silently approve newer plan.
Legacy settings and unrelated fields are preserved.
Fresh verification `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description: Tests first (test-driven-development): extend the headless state tests using rendered(4L), onApproveClicked(true, snapshot(4L)), then onStateUpdate(snapshot(5L, status=STATUS_WORKING)). Assert INVALIDATED, PLAN_CHANGED_KEY, capturedPlanRevision==4L, approveEnabled==false and forced click Blocked. This must fail against the unconditional PENDING→WORKING success branch. Table-test older/newer revisions, zero after nonzero capture, malformed/null/negative/over-MAX token, missing task, and same-revision success at 0L/4L/MAX_SAFE_PLAN_REVISION. Malformed WORKING tokens use REVISION_UNUSABLE_KEY; mismatches PLAN_CHANGED_KEY; missing task TASK_MISSING_KEY. After invalidation, late same-revision WORKING/error/send-failed callbacks never rearm or finish. Pin both orders of error vs mismatching WORKING callbacks; no auto retry or token substitution. Preserve existing duplicate-click, disposal, disconnected, READY-status-change and transport-is-not-acceptance assertions. In PlanApprovalContractTest reuse connectedSender/singlePayload to assert updateSettings(ProjectSettings(...nondefault values...)) still emits exactly approvalMode, speedModeDelayMs, agentCommand, enableAgentTeams with the supplied values—never executionProfile, deliveryPolicy, attribution, taskSizing or unknown fields. No new harness.

Fix only PlanReviewApprovalState.onStateUpdate's success branch under the existing synchronized(lock). For PENDING + present + WORKING, validate the effective token before reporting success: `val revision = snapshot.revision.effectiveOrNull(); val reason = when { revision == null -> REVISION_UNUSABLE_KEY; revision != capturedRevision -> PLAN_CHANGED_KEY; else -> null }; phase = if (reason == null) Phase.FINISHED else Phase.INVALIDATED; notice = reason; return true`. Retain all other unusableReason/staleReason handling. Error handling stays fail-closed, nonthrowing and uses existing actionable notice keys; late errors never release INVALIDATED/DISPOSED. Never replace capturedRevision, finish on local send alone, change decoder/legacy-zero semantics, or make expectedPlanRevision optional. Update comments to say authoritative WORKING for the SAME rendered revision. PlanReviewDialog already applies notices and closes only on FINISHED, so no UI changes. Make the reproduction green without rewriting landed approval routing.

Single final verification gate: from repository root run exactly `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test`, ensuring tests execute freshly (not only UP-TO-DATE/cache), and retain command/exitCode/outputTail for complete_task. Full consuming-package regression includes existing PlanApprovalContractTest, BoardApprovalTest (card/context/drag routes), PlanReviewApprovalStateTest, settings and delivery presentation. Existing assertions stay intact apart from additive coverage in owned tests. Coordinate `jetbrains-gradle` resource for shared outputs and release on success/failure; never clean peer builds. Linux/macOS use the pinned command with a native compatible JDK; Windows uses gradlew.bat operationally, but obtain POSIX/WSL gate evidence rather than relabelling Windows output. If unavailable report the environment failure, do not upgrade dependencies to bypass it. No producer schema/protocol or launcher changes, so no unrelated package gate.

One final adversarial self-review of these three files: approval followed by newer/older/malformed WORKING, ERROR before/after it, duplicate clicks, same-revision zero success, deletion, disposal and reconnect. Verify no path sends a replacement token or reports a newer plan approved; all settings/status/profile/evidence UI and peer dirty bytes remain untouched. Existing BoardApproval and wire tests must still prove every entrypoint quotes the rendered snapshot and required approveTask has no default/optional overload. Fix findings within owned files and refresh the same gate if bytes change; complete_task with fresh evidence. No Git writes or direct .moe edits; wrappers own delivery; I06 owns whole-epic integration/docs.
